portInfo.description: Port Everglades (Broward County) is a major South Florida homeport with eight published cruise terminal pages, each listing a street address, berth length/depth where given, and parking garage or lot references. Terminal 4 is identified as the Disney Cruise Line terminal that opened in Fall 2023 with a Finding Nemo theme. Guests ages 18+ must clear a security checkpoint with ID at each entrance. Cruise-line packages often include airport or hotel transfers; confirm with the line rather than assuming a port-run shuttle. Door-threshold WGS84 pins are not published on the terminal pages reviewed, so map pins stay null.

thingsToDo.shortCall: **≥4 h.** One beach or Las Olas block + return; keep ≥90 min buffer on embarkation days. Skip Everglades.
thingsToDo.standardCall: **≥6 h.** Beach + Las Olas lunch; watch I-595/US-1 congestion — ≥90 min return.
thingsToDo.longerCall: Beach day plus Riverwalk, or a pre-/post-cruise hotel night in Fort Lauderdale rather than compressing Everglades into a turnaround.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Confirm the **exact terminal number** on your cruise documents before instructing a rideshare — Port Everglades spreads guests across eight separately addressed buildings.

gettingThere.fromTerminal: Terminal 2 — 1801 SE 20th St; berth 1,602 ft / 31 ft depth
gettingThere.publicTransport: **Airport (FLL).** Port Everglades Getting Here page states average taxi fare FLL→port about $18–$21 (subject to change) and notes many cruise packages include transfers. Drive time minutes **Not verified** on that page. **Parking.** Terminal pages cite Heron Garage (1,818 spaces), Palm Garage (1,966 spaces), and Lots B/C; Terminal 29 has a free shuttle to Palm Garage. **Public transit.** Detailed bus/rail walk instructions from each door **Not verified**.
